cards.title: Ikea Trip Reveals Your Parenting Wins and Fails
cards.body: A shopping trip to Ikea becomes a reckoning moment for what domestic wisdom you've actually passed to your children. The pre-university furniture haul exposes gaps in your parenting lessons.

cards.title: Kids' Quiz: Test Knowledge With Child-Set Questions
cards.body: Five multiple-choice questions created by children test your knowledge on surprising topics. Submit your own junior brainteasers for future quizzes.

cards.title: Finding Joy in Suburban Life With Your Family
cards.body: A family's move to suburban Melbourne initially felt dull until they discovered hidden excitement in local community. Sometimes the best moments happen when you stop looking for thrills elsewhere.

cards.title: Safe Alcohol Amounts During Pregnancy Explained
cards.body: Learn whether any amount of alcohol is truly safe during pregnancy and what risks exist for the developing fetus. Medical guidance clarifies myths and facts about alcohol consumption while pregnant.

cards.title: Teens Missing School Despite Official Enrollment Records
cards.body: Thousands of teenagers are enrolled in college but not actually attending, flying under the radar of official statistics. The children's commissioner warns this hidden crisis affects education accountability.
